exposure: hospitals without changes in management policies
hospitals with changes in management policies
changes in maternity and neonatal unit policies towards extremely preterm infants
cohort: Extremely preterm infants (born at <27 weeks of gestational age) in ten European regions
finding: European hospitals that reported changes in management policies for extremely preterm infants experienced greater reductions in mortality compared to hospitals where policies remained unchanged.
mod_finding: The lowest gestational age at which maternity units reported performing a cesarean section for acute distress of a singleton non-malformed fetus decreased between 2003 and 2012.
